title: Steadfast
features: Role-based secure sign-in (Physician, Medical Assistant, Patient, Practice Admin) with MFA
Patient registration, enrollment, program + membership status, care team, consent
MA manual entry of weight + body composition (Hume Body Pod or other approved device), source + entered-by on every value
Weight + body-composition trend graphs, estimates labelled, missing distinct from zero, audit trail on corrections
Blood pressure + pulse entry, history chart, clinician-configured review flags (no diagnosis)
Laboratory results with units, reference range, lab abnormal flag, attached report, physician review
Medication + treatment record separating entered list, authorized plan, patient-reported adherence, clinical review
Configurable monthly patient check-in with not-emergency disclaimer, responses create staff tasks
MA dashboard: due check-ins, missing measurements, ready-for-physician-review
Physician dashboard: review queue, trends, document assessment, mark reviewed, assign follow-up
Patient portal: own trends, check-in, permitted meds, education, non-emergency messages
Notifications + tasks with minimal PHI, automated vs clinician-sent distinction
Operational reporting + role-checked, logged CSV export
Admin: users, roles, permission matrix, access removal
HIPAA-first: audit log, encryption, least privilege, future device-integration ready data model

bottomTabBar.note: STAFF bar (Physician / MA / Admin). Flat white bar, hairline top border, rounded outline 24px icons, label 12px. Active tab = accent #4165FE icon + label with small accent pill indicator; inactive = #8A90A8. Reused verbatim on every staff screen that shows nav.

patientTabBar.note: PATIENT portal bar, same styling as staff bar. Used only on patient-portal screens (nav values prefixed 'patient:').

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top app header: 59px safe area, then screen title in Bodoni Moda 26/600 left, right side a round 36px avatar of signed-in user with a small role chip (e.g. 'MA', 'MD'). Patient screens show practice name 'Northside Metabolic Health' small caption above the title.
sharedComponents.reviewBadge: Review status chip used everywhere: 'Unreviewed' (warning #D97706 on #FEF3C7), 'Ready for MD review' (accent #4165FE on #E9EDFF), 'Reviewed by Dr. Marsh - Oct 20' (success #16A34A on #DCFCE7). Never show a flagged value as reviewed without the green chip.
sharedComponents.sourceTag: Small mono-style tag on every measurement: device + who entered, e.g. 'Hume Body Pod - J. Lee, MA' or 'Patient-reported'. Patient-entered values use a dashed outline tag; staff-entered solid.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill 52px tall, #4165FE fill, white Questrial 16/600 label, pressed #2E52E6, disabled #C9D2F7. Secondary button: pill, white fill, 1.5px #4165FE border, accent label. Text input: 12px radius, 1px #E2E6F2 border, white fill, focus = 2px #6784FE ring, error = #DC2626 border + helper text, unit suffix chip inside right edge. Card: 20px radius white, soft shadow. Chip: pill 32px, #E9EDFF fill + #4165FE label when selected, white + border when not.
